name: PARADISE
detailed_description:
"PARADISE" is a small 3D adventure game played from a third-person perspective.

Take your girl friend to Paradise Resort, the largest theme park in the country.

Game Features

Take your friend to attractions, restaurants, and experiences they might enjoy.

Long lines may disappoint your friend.

Buy a PPP (Paradise Premium Pass) to skip the lines.

Whether your friend enjoys an activity will affect how much they like you.

If you’re short on money, earn some and manage your budget.

Player Controls

  • Move: W, A, S, D

  • Jump: Spacebar

  • Run: Shift

  • Interact: E

  • Confirm: Left Click

  • Pause Menu: ESC

  • Options: Tab
